<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
global $wp_rewrite; $wp_rewrite->set_permalink_structure('/%postname%/'); $wp_rewrite->flush_rules();
if ( ! get_page_by_path( 'thingamablocks-demo' ) ) {
	$registry = WP_Block_Patterns_Registry::get_instance();
	$end      = ( new DateTimeImmutable( '+3 days', wp_timezone() ) )->format( 'Y-m-d\T17:00:00' );
	$content  = '';
	foreach ( array( 'sale-banner', 'logo-marquee', 'pricing-toggle', 'launch-countdown' ) as $slug ) {
		$pattern = $registry->get_registered( 'thingamablocks/' . $slug );
		if ( $pattern ) {
			$content .= $pattern['content'] . "\n\n";
		}
	}
	// Patterns ship without a date (the editor sets one on insert); give the demo one.
	$content = str_replace( 'wp:thingamablocks/countdown {', 'wp:thingamablocks/countdown {"endDate":"' . $end . '",', $content );
	$content = str_replace( 'wp:thingamablocks/countdown {"endDate":"' . $end . '",}', 'wp:thingamablocks/countdown {"endDate":"' . $end . '"}', $content );
	// Saved through the content filter (kses) an Author or Contributor gets, so
	// the editor tests catch attributes it would strip.
	$id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => 'Thingamablocks demo', 'post_name' => 'thingamablocks-demo', 'post_content' => wp_slash( $content ) ) );
	// The Downloads dropdown is added after, unfiltered: its button uses a
	// GenerateBlocks icon (an inline SVG), which the filter strips for those
	// users on any GB button, a known GenerateBlocks limitation.
	$dropdown = $registry->get_registered( 'thingamablocks/downloads-dropdown' );
	if ( $id && $dropdown ) {
		kses_remove_filters();
		wp_update_post( array( 'ID' => $id, 'post_content' => wp_slash( get_post_field( 'post_content', $id ) . "\n\n" . $dropdown['content'] ) ) );
		kses_init_filters();
	}
}
